---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a capability this project doesn't have yet
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What problem does this solve**

Describe the problem or use case — not the solution yet.

**Proposed approach**

If you have one in mind, describe it. If not, that's fine — the problem statement is the
useful part.

**Alternatives considered**

Any workarounds you're using today, or other approaches you ruled out and why.

**Would this be a breaking change?**

If you can tell, note whether this looks additive or would require changing an existing
public API — see `STABILITY.md` for what counts as breaking.
